messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

function.name: route_estimate_time
function.description: Estimate the travel time for a specific route with optional stops. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point for the journey.

stops.description: Additional cities or points of interest to stop at during the journey ordered.

message.reasoning:
We need to estimate travel times using the tool `route_estimate_time`. We have three scenarios:

1) Start NYC -> Philadelphia (费城), Washington DC, Atlanta, Miami.

2) Start NYC -> Philadelphia? Wait second scenario says "不停止在亚特兰大" meaning skip Atlanta; so start NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami.

But original text: "如果我从纽约出发，途经费城、华盛顿特区和亚特拉大的最后抵达迈阿密". So first includes all four stops including Atlanta. Second: "如果我不停留在亚特兰大，直接从华盛顿特区前往迈阿密", implies we still include Philadelphia and Washington but not Atlanta. Third: "如果我从改成从费城出发，停留华盛顿特区，然后抵达迈阿密": Starting from Philadelphia instead of New York, then Washington DC, then Miami.

Thus calls:

First call: start_location="New York City", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C.","Atlanta"].

Second call: start_location="New York City", end_location="Miami", stops=["Philadelphia","Washington D.C."]. Actually if skipping Atlanta, maybe also skip Philadelphia? But phrase "directly from Washington DC to Miami" after stopping at Washington DC suggests you might still pass through Philadelphia? It says "if I don't stay in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami". That could mean path: NYC->Philadelphia->WashingtonDC->Miami. We'll keep Philadelphia as intermediate because it's part of earlier route. So stops list remains same minus Atlanta.

Third call: start_location="Philadelphia", end_location="Miami", stops=["Washington D.C."]

We'll use the function accordingly.
